e.title: Rippy (再保险定价 Python)
e.summary: 轻量模拟型再保险定价包（pythactuary，7★）：频率-严重度复合分布模拟建模（PyPI）
e.body: Rippy（pythactuary/rippy，7★，PyPI: rippy）是轻量快速的模拟型再保险定价 Python 包：核心是频率-严重度（compound distribution）模拟——FrequencySeverityModel 支持多种频率/严重度分布组合并抽样损失。对 RIAA：再保险定价的轻量入门（类比 [[reinspy]]、reinspy 的模拟侧），适合教学原型与快速 XOL/分层损失分析。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：rippy 再保险定价包（FrequencySeverityModel 复合分布模拟，PyPI 可装）
e.summary_en: Lightweight simulation-based reinsurance pricing package (pythactuary, 7★): frequency-severity compound-distribution modeling (PyPI)
e.summary_hk: 輕量模擬型再保險定價包（pythactuary，7★）：頻率-嚴重度複合分佈模擬建模（PyPI）
e.body_en: Rippy (pythactuary/rippy, 7★, PyPI: rippy) is a simple, fast, lightweight simulation-based reinsurance pricing package: its core is frequency-severity (compound distribution) simulation — the FrequencySeverityModel class sets up and samples compound distributions over a range of frequency and severity distributions. For RIAA: a light on-ramp to reinsurance pricing (like [[reinspy]] on the simulation side), well suited to teaching prototypes and quick XOL/layer loss analyses.
e.body_hk: Rippy（pythactuary/rippy，7★，PyPI: rippy）是輕量快速的模擬型再保險定價 Python 包：核心是頻率-嚴重度（compound distribution）模擬——FrequencySeverityModel 支持多種頻率/嚴重度分佈組合並抽樣損失。對 RIAA：再保險定價的輕量入門（類比 [[reinspy]] 的模擬側），適合教學原型與快速 XOL/分層損失分析。
